If you’re ready to get the smile you know you deserve, call us today to schedule your veneer consultation in Scottsdale, AZ! What are veneers? Veneers are thin pieces of porcelain that change the color, size, or shape of your teeth. Typically, they are no thicker than a contact lens, and they are your most natural-looking option for a smile transformation. We will evaluate you and your goals during your consultation to ensure that you have all the information you need to make the best choice for you! Why choose us? We’re reimagining the dental experience, and we can’t wait to show you what this new age of dentistry has to offer. Comfort, compassion, and integrity of care are at the core of our practice. From the moment you step into our lobby, you will experience the difference. Here, luxury meets dentistry, and you deserve it. No. Because the preparation process involves shaving some enamel, you will need to always protect your teeth, though. How long do veneers last? With proper care, your veneers will last you 15-20 years. Don’t use your teeth as tools, and they’ll last you a long time! Do porcelain veneer break easily? No! Despite their size, porcelain veneers are actually really strong. They can break, but it’s unlikely to happen with normal use. What is the pain level involved in porcelain veneers? You shouldn’t experience any pain with porcelain veneers. If you do experience any discomfort after your finals are placed, it should subside quickly.
